page.title: About us
page.summary: A legal strategy team focused on resolving complex problems with judgment, method, and clear communication.
page.intro: Astra Legal exists to support legal decisions that require more than filing work: context reading, document order, strategy, and professional responsibility.

cards.title: Legal judgment
cards.description: We do not sell absolute certainty. We explain scenarios, risks, and possible next steps.

cards.title: Careful communication
cards.description: We translate legal complexity into understandable decisions for people, companies, and authorities.

cards.title: International view
cards.description: The site and services are prepared for Spanish, English, and Chinese-speaking contexts.

page.trustTitle: Before acting, the matter is organized.
page.trustDescription: Each service starts with context, scope, and a responsible route. Sensitive information is requested only when the channel and objective are clear.

trustItems.title: Clear method
trustItems.description: Facts, documents, deadlines, and risks are separated before recommending an action.

trustItems.title: Information care
trustItems.description: The first contact stays general until scope and channel are confirmed.

trustItems.title: Multilingual attention
trustItems.description: The first approach can be prepared in Spanish, English, or Chinese depending on the matter.

page.ctaTitle: Share the context before deciding the route.
page.ctaDescription: Astra Legal can review general context and identify a responsible next step. Do not send sensitive documents until the channel and scope are confirmed.
